description: Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-17 standing on a circular paved forecourt in front of a war-damaged building in the 1070 Apartments project district of southern Aleppo. Recorded by spottingmode in December 2018 with no airframe linked. Confirmed on Esri imagery of 23 April 2024 as an aircraft deliberately positioned on a circular pad, which is why it is treated as a monument rather than as debris, though the ruined state of the surrounding building means public access and upkeep are both uncertain. No serial is published.
